introHtml: Custom basketball memo office clips bring a sporty touch to any desk. These clips feature a basketball design that appeals to coaches, players, and fans. They are perfect for team offices, sports marketing departments, or corporate gifts for basketball enthusiasts. Made from durable metal with a clip back, they hold papers securely while showing off your logo. Choose from full-color imprint or one-color debossing to match your brand. Order in bulk for tournaments, pep rallies, or employee appreciation.
